def draw_diagonals(size, pattern='both'):
    """Either both main diagonals or anti-diagonal or main diagonal"""
    import numpy as np
    grid = np.zeros((size, size), dtype=int)
    if pattern == 'both':
        for i in range(size):
            grid[i, i] = 1  # main diagonal
            grid[i, size-1-i] = 1  # anti-diagonal
    elif pattern == 'main':
        for i in range(size):
            grid[i, i] = 1
    elif pattern == 'anti':
        for i in range(size):
            grid[i, size-1-i] = 1
    
    return grid
